name: Melilot
message: 「Is someone getting a year older really something to be so happy about... It's a mystery.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Still, with this many... I'm struggling to find places to put them away.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I already have enough mail-order knockoffs as it is... *sigh*...」

name: Melilot
message: 「By the way. I've been wondering for a little while now, what are you hiding behind your back?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, it's not a nuisance at all. If it's a present from you.」
